title: 156,084 → 31 days later: 0 — animated counter
description: Looping teaser: a counter races from 0 to 156,084 (votes, June 9, 2026), then “31 days later: 0” fades in with an empty verification box after “BOXES CHECKED:”.
alt_text: Animation: a large number counts up rapidly to 156,084, labeled votes, June 9 2026, the most in Maine Dem Senate primary history. Then in dusty red: 31 days later: 0 — withdrawn July 8, denying everything. Boxes checked: an empty amber square.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Animated GIF teaser in the site’s restrained archival voice. Copyright/attribution is embedded in the GIF as a comment block. First frame is partial by design — pair with a static card where platforms preview frame 1.
